study: Passenger requests near a vehicle or a tree
setting: Prepared Windows presentation application, Microsoft Edge, original UAE driver-view photos, local Whisper for the previously submitted voice example. Timing starts when the user submits and ends when the browser displays the decision. Transcription is timed separately. Native image coordinates are pixels from the top left.
scope: The reported cases and their diagnostic comparisons were used in development. The last four requests and their separate road taps came from four other existing gallery drives. An independent AI image reviewer froze their references before the final app run. This study counts on-screen results, not permission to stop or vehicle clearance.

independent_scoring.reviewer: Independent AI visual reviewer. The reference vehicle/trees, plausible empty-ground polygons and controls were marked using original public UAE driver-view photos before this reviewer opened the corresponding app results. No human adjudication.
independent_scoring.score_criteria: Native-pixel point in any independently marked eligible polygon. Guided choices earn separate credit, and Save is checked only after explicit selection. Landmark box overlap is IoU, with 0.50 the recognition threshold. No legal access or traffic-safety validation.

initial_transfer.firsts: Four distinct previously enrolled public gallery drives outside the eight vehicle/tree diagnostic drives. These exact source/instruction pairs were held back. Later changes or replay are post-holdout diagnostics.
initial_transfer.interpretation: N27 is a false refusal; the intended body was among those outlined. N42 was a clickable direct proposal, 55 px outside the independent area, visibly on a raised concrete kerb. It was never saved in this test. N18 and N56 correctly offered no ground.

limits: Small, deliberately diverse UAE photo sample, unsuitable for a deployment accuracy estimate.
Landmark recognition and finding an off-lane destination are separate judgements. Photos cannot establish current legality, moving traffic, available clearance or a passenger-side door clearance.
Post-fix scores on already opened diagnoses do not replace the untouched transfer scores.

extra_independent_scoring.limitations: Single eligible plus single negative. Cases chosen visually and annotated by an independent AI reviewer; no human confirmation.
